blocks.text: NAGOYA—Long before Alex Eala steps off her flight from Singapore, anticipation is already building around the Asian Games in Aichi Prefecture, home to Japan’s largest Filipino community. Thousands of overseas Filipino workers are expected to turn out at the Nagoya City Higashiyama Park Tennis Center, where Eala begins her Asian Games 2026 campaign.
